 Order

Heard Sri Shivakumar Kallur, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Veeranagouda Malipatil,
learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent Nos.1 to 6.
2.

Writ petition is filed with the following prayer:
"(A) A writ of mandamus directing the respondents No: 1 to 5 to deposit the award a m o u n t i n t e r m s o f A n n e x u r e - A d a t e d 1 4 . 0 1 . 2 0 0 0 v i d e N o PA:s:::1:8:97-98 and pay the statutory benefits and also the interest for all these period and issue direction to the respondents to issue notice u/sec.
12(2) of land Acquisition Act.
B) Issue writ of mandamus directing respondents that the acquisition proceedings in respect of the suit land Sy. No: 645 measuring 12 acre 14 guntas of Nagalapur village Tq: dist: Yadgir has lapsed and direct respondents to handover the possession of the above suit land land Sy. No: 645 measuring 12 acre 14 guntas of Nagalapur village Tq: Dist: Yadgir to the petitioner as per sec. 24(2)
of the right to fair compensation Act-2013.
NC: 2024:KHC-K:2170 c) Issue any writ or order or directions as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in circumstances of the case,
in ends of justice and equity."
3. Grievance of the writ petitioners is that their land in Sy.No.645, measuring 12 acres 14 guntas,
situated at Nagalpur village, has been acquired for construction of Mallireddy pond and the land got submerged in the pond and award came to be passed on 14.01.2000.
However, till today the compensation amount is not deposited.

4. Learned counsel for the writ petitioners reiterating the grounds urged in the writ petition contended that despite sufficient representations given by the writ petitioner, the compensation amount was not paid to the petitioner.

5. Learned High Court Government Pleader however submits that the correspondence has taken place between the Minor Irrigation Department, Land Acquisition Officer and the learned Deputy Commissioner and therefore, compensation would be deposited at the earliest.
6. Placing the submission of the learned High Court Government Pleader, following order is passed.
